title: Mitigating photon escape in thin-film photovoltaic devices via non-reciprocal optical path
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,253-263
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05708F, Paper
Jing-De Chen, Hao Ren, Ye-Fan Zhang, Song-Jie Zhou, Jia-Liang Zhang, Zhi-Yuan Deng, Yan-Qing Li, Elvira Fortunato, Rodrigo Martins, Jian-Xin Tang
Subwavelength periodic pyramids with high-refractive index generate broadband non-reciprocal optical path, mitigating the trade-off between light harvesting and charge extraction and pushing efficiency of organic solar cells to 20.70%.
